headline: Contracts with Tolman Mass Insight and Branching Minds, a Girl’s Flag Football Sports Program, and a template administrator contract.
summary: The meeting covers two contracts, a sports program, an updated organizational chart, and a policy revision. It also includes a food service update from Aramark and a possible closed session on an employee's job performance.
items: Student reports from Charles E. Shea High School, William E. Tolman High School, and Jacqueline M. Walsh School for Performing and Visual Arts
Food service program update from Aramark
Approval of Tolman Mass Insight contract
Approval of Girl’s Flag Football Sports Program
Second passage approval of template administrator contract for principals and assistant principals
Second passage of revision to Policy BEDB
Possible executive session on the job performance of a District employee
Return to open session and reporting of votes
location: Jenks Junior High School, 350 Division Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
